product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Knaps Pouring Shield, 1", Clear
features: Designed, engineered, and tested by KitchenAid
Sits on top of the bowl to help prevent ingredients from splattering
Designed for KitchenAid stainless steel stand mixer bowls. Does not fit glass or ceramic bowls, Material: Plastic, Finish: Unfinished
Note: Please look on the bottom of the mixer for the model number, any other source could provide the wrong model number
Fits Bowl-Lift Models: K4SS, KSM450, KSM455, KSM500, K5(A), K5SS, KP50PS, KSM5, KSM50HDP, KG25H0X, KG25H3X, KG25H7X, KSM6573

Fits Tilt-Head Models: K45, K45SS, KN15E1X, KSM75, KSM85PS, KSM88PSQ, KSM90, KSM95, KSM96, KSM97, KSM100, KSM103, KSM105, KSM110, KSM120, KSM150, KSM152, KSM153, KSM154, KSM155, KSM180, KSM150A, KSM151PS, KSM158, KSM160A
description: The one-piece pouring shield fits onto your mixing bowl to help you add ingredients without making a mess. It also helps keep lightweight ingredients like flour from flying out of the bowl when you’re mixing. The pouring shield is dishwasher safe. Fits models K45SS, KSM75, KSM95, KSM150PS, KSM152PS, K4, K5, KP50, KSM5, KSM50, KSM500PS and KSM450.
